This class represents the scheduled code.

detaileddescription.para: The main data structure is a map from scheduled cycle to instructions. During scheduling, the data structure explicitly represents all stages/iterations. When the algorithm finshes, the schedule is collapsed into a single stage, which represents instructions from different loop iterations.
The SMS algorithm allows negative values for cycles, so the first cycle in the schedule is the smallest cycle value.
